subject: HyperNova capacity request — provisional GPU allocation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: HyperNova capacity request — provisional GPU allocation

Team,

HyperNova (contact: Claire Beaumont) has signaled intent to commit to a Dedicated cluster for inference in Q4. Key numbers from recent SOW draft:
- Model: 70B decoder-only (fp16 runtime)
- Expected steady-state qps: 55
- P50 latency target: 65ms (token-level)
- Typical request size: 1k tokens, average response 400 tokens
- Estimated concurrency: 48 streams (bursty up to ~80 for short windows)

Attached is my quick capacity estimate and the MAP. We need an internal confirmation of available GPU capacity for a provisional reservation while legal/finance finalize terms. Ask: can infra place a soft hold on the equivalent of 8 x A100-80GB (or 12 x A100-40GB / 6 x H100-80GB) in us-west for 14 days? If not possible, list nearest alternative (region/sku) and estimated lead time.

Business context: the deal is late-stage; HyperNova expects a short blackout if we can’t guarantee capacity. I’d like to propose a 7–14 day provisional hold to bridge contract signatures. Please include a quick cost delta estimate for a reserved pool (monthly burn) and note any blockers (quota, maintenance windows).

Attachments: capacity_estimate.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri yom_das@redwood.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HyperNova capacity request — provisional GPU allocation

Priyom —

Quick inventory check (snapshot taken 2026-07-21 11:50 UTC):
- us-west-2: A100-80GB: 12 free, A100-40GB: 26 free, H100-80GB: 4 free (some reserved for infra testing)
- us-east-1: A100-80GB: 6 free, A100-40GB: 18 free

Notes and recommendations:
1) For the workload you describe (70B, 1k tokens request/400 tokens response), our internal perf tests show ~6 streams per A100-80GB to meet 65ms p50 using current runtime config (fp16 + kv-cache). That maps to ~8 A100-80GB for ~48 steady streams. H100 could reduce GPU count but has lower immediate availability here.
2) I can provision a named reserved pool (e.g., dedicated-hn-1145) and place a soft hold for up to 7 days without formal billing change. For a longer hold (14 days) we need finance signoff to convert to a provisional reserved allocation to avoid re-claim during autoscale events.
3) Estimated provisional monthly cost (ballpark):
   - 8 x A100-80GB reserved pool (us-west-2): ~$55,000/mo (pre-tax, rough)
   - 6 x H100-80GB reserved: ~$78,000/mo

Action items I can take now:
- Create provisional pool and tag resources (soft hold for 7 days)
- Open Jira INFRA-6782 to formalize long-hold request and track quota changes

Attached: cluster_inventory_snapshot-20260721.csv

If you want the 14-day hold, tell me to escalate to finance; otherwise I’ll put a 7-day soft hold tonight (UTC).

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Platform Capacity Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HyperNova capacity request — provisional GPU allocation

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the quick inventory.

Decision: please escalate and request the 14-day provisional hold. HyperNova has signaled they will sign the commitment this week but need the runway. Evelyn & I want the team to aim for the us-west-2 A100-80GB mapping if possible (cost delta acceptable).

Please:
- Dylan: escalate to finance for provisional reserved allocation and tag the pool dedicated-hn-1145.
- Priyom: notify Claire/Procurement that we will hold capacity for 14 days and request any timeline constraints from them (evidence for legal).
- Lukas: loop legal on the capacity-escrow clause; we may need a clause that allows 30-day conversion to reserved billing if deal closes.

Related: HubSpot deal is HN-2026-1145 (link in thread metadata).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Beaumont <claire@hypernova.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hypernova.ai, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HyperNova capacity request — provisional GPU allocation

Priyom / Karthik —

Thanks, this is great context. HyperNova confirms we can move to signature by end of week; a 14-day provisional hold is what we need to avoid a go/no-go pause on our side. Please confirm the exact SKUs and the cluster tag you will use so we can reflect it in procurement paperwork (we prefer explicit mapping to A100-80GB if available).

We will also share a P.O. number once our procurement team finishes internal approval (cc'd). Expect a DocuSign for the SOW shortly.

Best,
Claire Beaumont
Head of Platform Partnerships, HyperNova AI
